items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Pee Wee Erwin took his place as the leader, he became our leader

ctx.x: But now, you stayed in Condon's for three years.

Well, the story behind that is I worked there for a year and a half -- let's see, we're getting into the fifties -- between '50 and '51, Bobby was very busy doing other things, so Pee Wee Erwin took his place as the leader, he became our leader -- and there's a great traditional man.
Oh, what a man. Anything you want to say nice, just include it and wrap it all up in one package and say Pee Wee Erwin, and that's it Dizzy. That's right. Tommy Dorsey, all the great bands ...
